text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
On the stage where <chrname>-san shines the brightest,
she is truly about to outshine everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Yes! Let us clash with everything we've built during our days with our Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, just a little.
Because I've always kept in my heart the desire to run
a race worthy of you, Trainer <username>.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
However, we have become stronger.
Every time we lost, we overcame that weakness
and grew. I have no doubts whatsoever.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...Mm, it's different from before.
...Much, much stronger and faster.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Let's show them, Bitter Glasse.
Our evolution, to our greatest rivals...!

The "URA Finals"—
The final race is finally about to begin!
